businesses.name: Accelerated compute silicon and systems
businesses.economicMeaning: Core platform business monetizing demand for accelerated computing through silicon and associated systems.
businesses.segmentationBasis: Conceptual operating segment; requires validation against reported segment disclosure.

revenueDriver.note: Segment revenue and cost disclosure has not yet been retrieved.

costDrivers.note: Economics are expected to depend on accelerator shipment volume, realized pricing, product mix and supply-chain costs; quantitative inputs require reported-segment evidence.

forecastAssumptions.rationale: Operating-baseline WACC supplied for the FCFF bridge; requires review against company-specific risk and cycle evidence.

growthConstraints.rationale: Bounded exploratory range for a cyclical, scaling semiconductor platform; must be replaced or refined using reported history, guidance and cycle evidence.

businesses.rationale: DCF is provisionally appropriate because the supplied evidence includes an unlevered FCFF bridge, normalized cash flows, WACC and terminal growth. It values operating capability without relying on market price.
applicabilityConditions: Validate the FCFF bridge against reported filings.
Separate current realized economics from future product-cycle expansion.
Incorporate supply, demand, pricing and customer-concentration evidence before finalization.
overlaps: Do not separately add software or networking economics unless reported disclosures establish non-overlapping revenue and cost bases.

businesses.name: Networking and interconnect
businesses.economicMeaning: Platform-adjacent networking and interconnect capability supporting accelerated-computing deployments.
businesses.segmentationBasis: Conceptual business line inferred from the supplied company classification; reported standalone economics are not yet available.

revenueDriver.note: Requires filing-based confirmation of revenue, margins and capital intensity.

costDrivers.note: Requires reported volume, pricing, product mix and cost disclosure.

growthConstraints.rationale: Exploratory bounds only pending reported segment history and management guidance; not a final forecast assumption.

businesses.rationale: Use DCF only after establishing whether networking is separately disclosed or economically embedded in the platform forecast.
applicabilityConditions: Avoid double counting networking revenue already included in consolidated FCFF forecasts.
overlaps: Potential overlap with accelerated compute systems and consolidated FCFF.

businesses.name: Platform software and ecosystem
businesses.economicMeaning: Software and ecosystem layer that may improve platform adoption, customer retention and long-run mix.
businesses.segmentationBasis: Conceptual business line; no standalone software revenue, margin or user metrics were supplied.

revenueDriver.note: User and ARPU economics are unknown; software should not receive standalone value until supported by evidence.

costDrivers.note: Standalone software margin and revenue are unknown.

growthConstraints.rationale: Exploratory bounds for a commercialization transition; standalone value requires commercial evidence and probability weighting.

businesses.rationale: No standalone software valuation is assigned at this stage. Any future software contribution should be modeled as probability-weighted commercial optionality rather than as realized revenue.
applicabilityConditions: Obtain evidence of software revenue, adoption, monetization and required investment.
Deduct incremental capital, financing and dilution where applicable.
overlaps: Potential overlap with platform pricing and accelerator demand.

valuationMethods.rationale: Primary method provisionally uses the supplied FCFF bridge and operating-baseline assumptions. Networking and software remain unvalidated components and must not be separately added without segment evidence.
Supplied normalized EBITDA and EV/EBITDA guardrail can serve as an operating cross-check, not the primary compiled valuation.
Supplied EV/FCF guardrail can cross-check the FCFF-based result; it is not used as the primary aggregation method.

scenarios.name: Base operating capability
scenarios.description: Current platform economics continue through a technology and capacity cycle, subject to validation of reported segments and guidance.

scenarios.name: Software and ecosystem commercialization
scenarios.description: Software monetization develops into a meaningful contributor, conditional on evidence of adoption, pricing and investment requirements.

probabilitiesCheck.note: Scenario probabilities are exploratory and require evidence-based calibration before finalization; software optionality must not be counted in the base operating forecast.

sources.label: Supplied operating baseline and valuation inputs

missingEvidence: Reported segment revenue, cost, margin and capex disclosure.
Standalone software adoption, monetization, retention and investment evidence.
Validation of the supplied internal FCFF forecast against reported SEC history.
Explicit financing, capital-requirement and dilution analysis for any optionality scenario.
crossChecks: Compare DCF against supplied EV/EBITDA and EV/FCF guardrails after validating forecast basis and avoiding price-based inference.
thesisChanges: No change to the operating thesis is authorized before segment and guidance evidence are retrieved.
Software remains probability-weighted optionality rather than realized standalone value.
Networking and software must not be added separately if their economics are already embedded in consolidated FCFF.
